1.d4 f5 2.g4 fxg4 3.e4 d5 4.Nc3.strategy: Adds a second attacker to d5 and defends the e4-pawn that Black's d-pawn hits, so White develops with a purpose. It is the sensible way to go on, since taking on d5 loses time to the queen's recapture, but White is still a pawn down and must find compensation in open play.
1.d4 f5 2.g4 fxg4 3.e4 d5 4.Nc3.name: Dutch Defence: Krejcik Gambit, Tate Gambit
